animations.name: Special 2 - Guitar Rotary Throw v2
animations.prompt: One rotational HORIZONTAL guitar throw toward the RIGHT, like a hammer throw. Start in the supplied Guitar pose. Bring the guitar to chest height, then sweep it sideways in a broad circular arc around the torso. Both hands hold its neck. Drive the motion with a strong waist twist that turns the CHEST TOWARD THE CAMERA, showing his front. The arms and guitar travel around the body at nearly constant chest height, like a horizontal bat swing. Extend both arms toward the RIGHT to release. At release, the guitar disappears in a compact blue-white electric burst near the hands. Empty arms continue the same circular follow-through, then recover to guard. Keep the whole guitar and burst inside the canvas. Fixed full-body camera, right-facing stance, planted feet, stable scale and horizontal position. Preserve Mileto and his reference guitar. Transparent background. No overhead chop, downward swing, vertical throwing arc, full-body spin, extra limbs, duplicate guitar or camera motion.
